_comment: Unseen query wordings for the language-generalisation test. Training only ever uses the 14 canonical sentences in data_contract.PHRASES; these sentences are used only at test time. Set A renames each concept (synonyms and clinical terms); set B describes what is happening. concept/concept_id follow data_contract.PHASES and data_contract.TOOLS. Drafted for review: every sentence must be checked by a clinician or the author before the results are reported.
